_description: Stamp transactions - individual stamp giving/receiving events

_schema.userPhone: string - Phone number of user (must exist in users.json)
_schema.sponsorId: string - ID of sponsor (must exist in sponsors.json)
_schema.amount: number - Number of stamps in this transaction (default: 1)

_note: Each transaction represents a single stamp-giving event. Multiple transactions can exist between the same user-sponsor pair.
